integrity: Analytic edge-cut identity and complete leaf-insertion/canonical-form enumeration; Python stdlib exact integer checks; no independent audit or bibliographic certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact unlabelled unrooted binary unit-edge trees with uniform fixed-size leaf sampling; exhaustive boundary only through fourteen tips, not numerical field inference or arbitrary edge weights. Prior methods use mean/variance and richer nested joint laws.
title: Fourteen taxa are the first marginal-rarefaction twins among unrooted binary phylogenies
